#+TITLE: org-plot option-parsing quirks

Keys are matched as substrings in org-plot's own order, so xmin also sets ymin
and timeind is read as ind.

#+PLOT: ind:1 deps:(2) with:lines xmin:5 ymax:20
| a | b |
|---+---|
| 1 | 4 |
| 2 | 9 |

#+plot: ind:1 deps:(2) with:points title:Lowercase
| a | b |
|---+---|
| 1 | 4 |
| 2 | 9 |

#+PLOT: timeind:t deps:(2)
| a | b |
|---+---|
| 1 | 4 |
| 2 | 9 |

#+PLOT: ind: deps:(2)
| a | b |
|---+---|
| 1 | 4 |
| 2 | 9 |

#+PLOT: type:3d
| 1 | 2 |
| 3 | 4 |

#+PLOT: ind:1 deps:(2 3) with:lines line:"set style data lines"
| a | b | c |
|---+---+---|
| 1 | 4 | 2 |
| 2 | 9 | 3 |

#+PLOT:ind:1
| a | b |
|---+---|
| 1 | 4 |
